note: The two-plan repricing: Church at $30 a month or $300 a year and Ministry at $90 a month or $900 a year replace plus, pro and max (approved by the founder, 2026-10-27). There is no assigned ticket number; THE-378 is the next free id after THE-377. Stored plus and pro ids are read as Church and max as Ministry at read time through canonicalPlanId; no Firestore document is written or migrated. No firestore.rules, indexes, storage rules, env var or tenant data change. APPENDED, NEVER SUBSTITUTED: no other ticket's record was edited.

The suite still pins each id, price, trial and billing frequency against what the live API returned, and still asserts no retired identifier survives in comments.
